rows.notes: T054: installed 30 GWh/yr cells as of 2026-08-09 (installed basis: press). 10jqka 2026-08-09 says park phases 1 and 2 are 'fully in operation'; China Energy News 2026-08-17 says the base 'has' the capacity scale of 30 GWh cells + 20 GWh systems (only the 30 GWh cell figure used). Caveat: 10jqka and Sci-Tech Daily phrase the 30 GWh as 'after reaching full production (达产后)', and mass-production roll-off was only 2026-08-07, so 30 is commissioned design capacity, not demonstrated output; no per-phase GWh published (single lines >15 GWh). Nameplate unchanged (30).

T054: Xinhua 2026-08-14 (state press, installed basis: government/press): Sunwoda New Energy (山东欣旺达新能源有限公司, Zaozhuang High-tech Zone) 'phase 1 has formed 16 GWh capacity, phase 2 of 50 GWh is under accelerated construction' and cells are rolling off the lines (X2). Installed = 16 GWh at 2026-08-14. Nameplate raised from the 2021-23 figure of 30 GWh to 16 + 50 = 66 GWh (later source wins, D-014/D-017; phase 2 'under construction' = 加快建设; phase 2 has no due date, so ref_year 2026 is a publication-year fallback: 'ref_year: fallback, searched'). CONFLICT/UNRESOLVED: the earlier 30 GWh (20 lines, RMB20bn) came from an undated Dazhong Daily page and the 2021 agreement; Xinhua does not say whether the 30 GWh was re-scoped into 16 + 50. Also unclear whether the Geely-Sunwoda hybrid-cell project (RMB5bn, 800k sets, separate entity 山东吉利欣旺达) is inside the 16 GWh; a May-2026 EIA for 'Xinbang New Energy (Shandong)' ultra-fast-charge project (~52 GWh plant-wide, search snippet only) may be the phase 2. Lead should decide whether to keep 66. jv_partners left null.

T054: DATED FLOOR (D-025). At the 2020-07-10 phase-1 mass-production handover the project owner stated two HEV lines + one BEV line built, 'capable of 4 GWh/yr' (installed basis: company via press, republished by Sina Tech). The same page also states the phase-1 construction scope as ~8 GWh cells, so 4 GWh is the lines then built, not the phase-1 plan. Phase 2 was partly delivered by Aug 2023 (see earlier note) but no GWh was found, so the true current installed is higher than 4 GWh; this is a 6-year-old floor, entered with its true installed_as_of. Nameplate (30) and confidence unchanged.

T054: DATED FLOOR (D-025). Phase I ('factory one') entered production 2022-05-30 (Gasgoo 2022-05-31; CATL's own news page confirms the ceremony and 14-month build but gives no GWh). Gasgoo ties the Phase I base to 'an annual capacity of 25 GWh' (installed basis: press; the 25 GWh is the Feb-2021 Phase I design figure, not a stated measured installed figure, and 'factory one' may be only part of Phase I). CATL's Mar-2026 fundraising notice (via press, see earlier note) says stage 1 built/in production and stage 2 partly built, so 25 GWh is retained as a floor dated to commissioning. CAUTION: row confidence left at its prior 0.6 (not raised); the installed figure is a design-capacity paraphrase and the lead may prefer to lower it to <=0.5 and drop the installed value if design != installed is judged disqualifying.
